title: Verified-open dataset catalogue (datasets.yml) seeded with 3 sources
context: Per the binding cancer guardrails, no dataset enters a lesson until it passes the gate defined in gate-001. This task seeds datasets.yml - the single source of truth for every dataset - with at least three candidate teaching sources, each fully recorded and run through the gate, so later modules have vetted data to teach on.
objective: Seed datasets.yml with at least 3 candidate sources (e.g. a Bioconductor teaching expression set, DepMap, a SEER*Explorer/GLOBOCAN aggregate), each fully recorded against the gate-001 schema and either PASSING the gate or flagged/excluded with reason.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 3 candidate sources fully recorded and each PASSING the gate (e.g. a Bioconductor teaching expression set, DepMap, a SEER*Explorer/GLOBOCAN aggregate) - or flagged/excluded with reason if they fail.
Each record has a license snapshot (committed text + SHA-256 + archival URL) and a vendor-vs-fetch decision recorded.
No record has accessTier outside the permitted enum; no individual-level record without deIdentified=true + basis.
Reviewed and signed off by License+Data-Ethics (blocking).
resources: PLAN.md (binding cancer guardrails / Data, licensing & compliance)
